usages.explain: Expresses the meaning "to make something become a certain way," "to be the cause of something changing." This is a way to create transitive verbs for intransitive verbs that don't have corresponding transitive forms like 「凍る」(to freeze), 「湿る」(to become wet).

examples.content: きれいにする、または湿らせるためにスポンジで拭く。
examples.transcription: きれいにする、またはしめらせるためにすぽんじでふく。

examples.content: 彼は幸福そうに目を輝かせていた。
examples.transcription: かれはこうふくそうにめをかがやかせていた。
examples.mean: His eyes were shining with happiness.

usages.synopsis: N が N を V-させる

title: NがNをV-させる => to make somebody do something. to let somebody do something
